tasks.subject: Task 1: Agent UI Python trusts the configured agent list
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Remove the {claude,codex} filter and hardcoded SESSION_NAME agent alternation so any shape-valid --agent works.

**Files:** Modify flasks/agent_ui/agent_ui.py (SESSION_NAME ~26-29, allowed_agents ~226); Test flasks/agent_ui/tests/test_agent_ui.py.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- SESSION_NAME matches any [A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9_-]* agent.
- create_app(agents=("gemini",)) accepts gemini, rejects codex.
- Existing tests pass.

**Verify:** python -m pytest tests -v (agent_ui nix shell) all pass.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["flasks/agent_ui/agent_ui.py", "flasks/agent_ui/tests/test_agent_ui.py"], "verifyCommand": "python -m pytest tests -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["SESSION_NAME accepts any shape-valid agent", "create_app trusts passed agent list", "existing tests pass"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Agent UI Nix module stops hardcoding agents in shell guards
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Drop the redundant [claude codex] filter; interpolate the configured agent list into agent-ui-enter/agent-ui-session case guards and agent-ui-attach regex.

**Files:** Modify anixpkgs/pkgs/python-packages/flasks/agent_ui/module.nix (agents ~11-18, agentEnter ~22-33, agentSession ~50-53, agentAttach ~65).

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- agents = config.machines.features.agents.frameworks (no re-filter).
- enter/session case + attach regex accept configured agents + shell, generated from the list.
- Module parses.

**Verify:** nix-instantiate --parse module.nix; full build in Task 12.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["anixpkgs/pkgs/python-packages/flasks/agent_ui/module.nix"], "verifyCommand": "nix-instantiate --parse pkgs/python-packages/flasks/agent_ui/module.nix", "acceptanceCriteria": ["agents from NixOS option", "shell guards generated from list"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Thread a dedicated tmux socket + config through agent_ui.py
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Let Agent UI run tmux on an isolated -L socket with a -f config at server start so mouse mode is enabled without touching the user's tmux.

**Files:** Modify flasks/agent_ui/agent_ui.py (TmuxSessions ~77-137, create_app ~213-234, main ~470-499); Test tests/test_agent_ui.py.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- TmuxSessions(socket=..) prefixes every tmux call with -L <socket>.
- start() adds -f <config>; list/interrupt/terminate do not.
- --tmux-socket/--tmux-config CLI args reach TmuxSessions.

**Verify:** python -m pytest tests -v all pass.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["flasks/agent_ui/agent_ui.py", "flasks/agent_ui/tests/test_agent_ui.py"], "verifyCommand": "python -m pytest tests -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["-L socket prefixes commands", "-f config only on start", "CLI args wired"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Enable tmux mouse mode in the Agent UI Nix module
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Dedicated tmux socket 'agent-ui' + config file (set -g mouse on; history-limit) wired through the service and agent-ui-attach.

**Files:** Modify anixpkgs/pkgs/python-packages/flasks/agent_ui/module.nix (add agentTmuxConf; attach uses -L agent-ui; ExecStart passes --tmux-socket/--tmux-config).

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Config file with mouse on + large history-limit built.
- Service ExecStart passes --tmux-socket agent-ui --tmux-config <conf>.
- agent-ui-attach uses -L agent-ui.

**Verify:** nix-instantiate --parse; Task 12 build + manual wheel-scroll smoke.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["anixpkgs/pkgs/python-packages/flasks/agent_ui/module.nix"], "verifyCommand": "nix-instantiate --parse pkgs/python-packages/flasks/agent_ui/module.nix", "acceptanceCriteria": ["mouse-on tmux config", "socket+config passed to service", "attach on -L agent-ui"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Folio companion auth module
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Load an agent-ui-style secrets file; verify password (werkzeug); mint HMAC cookie + CSRF token.

**Files:** Create folio/backend/folio_backend/agent_auth.py, folio/backend/tests/test_agent_auth.py; Modify folio/backend/setup.py (add werkzeug).

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- load_secrets returns (secret_key bytes, password_hash) and raises on missing keys.
- check_password validates werkzeug hash; wrong/empty fail.
- is_authenticated accepts minted cookie, rejects others (constant-time).

**Verify:** python -m unittest tests.test_agent_auth -v (folio-backend nix shell) OK.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["folio/backend/folio_backend/agent_auth.py", "folio/backend/tests/test_agent_auth.py", "folio/backend/setup.py"], "verifyCommand": "python -m unittest tests.test_agent_auth -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["load_secrets validates keys", "password check works", "cookie roundtrip constant-time"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Ephemeral temp-dir session manager
tasks.description:
**Goal:** AgentSessions spawns/lists/kills folio-agent--<agent>--<id> tmux sessions on a dedicated socket, each in a temp dir keyed by session id.

**Files:** Create folio/backend/folio_backend/agent.py, folio/backend/tests/test_agent_sessions.py.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- spawn(agent) rejects unconfigured agents, creates <spool>/folio-agent-<id>, issues tmux -L socket [-f conf] new-session ... <workdir> <agent>.
- list() parses list-sessions, returns only well-formed configured folio-agent sessions.
- kill(name) validates name, kills session, removes matching temp dir only.

**Verify:** python -m unittest tests.test_agent_sessions -v OK.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["folio/backend/folio_backend/agent.py", "folio/backend/tests/test_agent_sessions.py"], "verifyCommand": "python -m unittest tests.test_agent_sessions -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["spawn creates dir + new-session", "list filters/parses", "kill removes only matching dir"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: Agent companion router + env-gated wiring in app.py
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Expose /agent/{login,auth-check,config,sessions}; register in create_app only when FOLIO_AGENTS and FOLIO_AGENT_SECRETS set.

**Files:** Create folio/backend/folio_backend/agent_router.py, folio/backend/tests/test_api_agent.py; Modify folio/backend/folio_backend/app.py (after SPA mount ~251).

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Unauth GET /agent/auth-check -> 401; after login -> 204.
- GET /agent/config -> {agents, csrf} when authed.
- POST/DELETE /agent/sessions require CSRF header + configured agent.
- With FOLIO_AGENTS unset, /agent/* absent (404).

**Verify:** python -m unittest discover -s tests -v OK.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["folio/backend/folio_backend/agent_router.py", "folio/backend/folio_backend/app.py", "folio/backend/tests/test_api_agent.py"], "verifyCommand": "python -m unittest discover -s tests -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["auth gate 401/204", "config returns agents+csrf", "csrf enforced", "routes env-gated"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 9: useMediaQuery hook + AgentPanel component
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Self-contained panel: login -> agent picker -> terminal iframe; plus a media-query hook.

**Files:** Create folio/frontend/src/agent/useMediaQuery.ts, AgentPanel.tsx, AgentPanel.module.css, AgentPanel.test.tsx.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Unauth shows password form; correct login reveals picker.
- Picking an agent calls spawn; iframe src includes /folio/agent/terminal/?arg=<name>.
- Existing session from listSessions reattaches without picker.
- Close session calls kill and returns to picker.

**Verify:** npm test -- --run src/agent/AgentPanel.test.tsx pass.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["folio/frontend/src/agent/useMediaQuery.ts", "folio/frontend/src/agent/AgentPanel.tsx", "folio/frontend/src/agent/AgentPanel.module.css", "folio/frontend/src/agent/AgentPanel.test.tsx"], "verifyCommand": "npm test -- --run src/agent/AgentPanel.test.tsx", "acceptanceCriteria": ["login->picker", "spawn->iframe", "reattach existing", "close->picker"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 10: Wire the companion into App.tsx with responsive layout
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Header menu button opens the companion; reader+agent side-by-side when wide, toggle when narrow; panel kept mounted so the terminal websocket survives toggles.

**Files:** Modify folio/frontend/src/App.tsx, App.test.tsx; Create folio/frontend/src/App.module.css.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Header 'Agent' button toggles the companion; library/reader unchanged when closed.
- >=1000px both render; <1000px one shows and button toggles.
- Reader pane stays mounted via hidden.

**Verify:** npm test -- --run src/App.test.tsx pass; npm run build succeeds.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["folio/frontend/src/App.tsx", "folio/frontend/src/App.module.css", "folio/frontend/src/App.test.tsx"], "verifyCommand": "npm test -- --run && npm run build", "acceptanceCriteria": ["agent button toggles companion", "responsive side-by-side/toggle", "reader stays mounted"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 11: Folio module — ttyd service, ports, nginx, agent env, secrets copy
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Serve the companion under Folio's origin: derive agents from the NixOS option, run folio-agent-terminal ttyd, add nginx auth_request locations, provide session/attach scripts, provision the secrets copy.

**Files:** Modify anixpkgs/pkgs/nixos/service-ports.nix (folio.agentTerminal), anixpkgs/pkgs/modules/folio/module.nix (options/env/scripts/ttyd/nginx/assert), anixpkgs/pkgs/nixos/features/services.nix (agentCompanion).

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- service-ports.folio.agentTerminal exists, distinct.
- Backend gets FOLIO_AGENTS/SECRETS/SPOOL/TMUX*/SESSION_CMD when companion enabled + agents non-empty.
- folio-agent-terminal ttyd serves base-path /folio/agent/terminal, gated by X-Folio-Agent-Authenticated.
- nginx adds = /folio/agent/auth-check (internal) + /folio/agent/terminal/ (ttyd, ws, auth_request).
- folio_agent.json provisioned as a copy of agent_ui.json via ExecStartPre.

**Verify:** nix-instantiate --parse each file; full eval/build in Task 12.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["anixpkgs/pkgs/nixos/service-ports.nix", "anixpkgs/pkgs/modules/folio/module.nix", "anixpkgs/pkgs/nixos/features/services.nix"], "verifyCommand": "nix-instantiate --parse pkgs/modules/folio/module.nix", "acceptanceCriteria": ["agentTerminal port", "companion env", "ttyd service", "nginx auth_request locations", "secrets copy"]}
```

tasks.description:
